title: AI--Assisted Exploration: DHOST Theories without Quantum Ghosts
summary: We ask whether a local symmetry can organize both classical degeneracy and perturbative stability in DHOST theories. An AI-assisted search finds a candidate in a constant-disformal image of Einstein gravity. We identify it as a field-dependent diffeomorphism plus a vertical translation of a spectator scalar and extend it to every regular first-derivative map $\widetilde g_{μν}=C(φ,X)g_{μν}-D(φ,X)\nabla_μφ\nabla_νφ$, which pulls the spectator translation back to an exact local gauge redundancy.
